entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker who tries to stop Olivia's wedding and kill her, remembering how his grandfather forced him to drink angel blood.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
aliases: Lady of our most illustrious house
entities.description: A vampire lady marrying Edgar Markov and plotting to control angels through Sigarda's blood and the Moonsilver Key.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: Sorin's grandfather and the groom, apparently under Olivia's influence, who joins hands with her to bind the angel's blood.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: An old archangel bound with red ribbons as a wedding gift and used for her blood, who is freed and shatters the hall with holy light.

entities.name: Katilda
entities.description: A witch's spirit separated from her body that bursts from the Moonsilver Key and frees Sigarda; the page does not name her.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer waiting outside the gates who jokes about cake and sees the golden light.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A planeswalker and werewolf waiting outside the gates with the rest of the allies.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker waiting outside the gates.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who says that weddings bring people together even for vampires.

entities.name: Adeline
entities.description: A cathar waiting outside with Chandra, who sees the golden light and the crumbling wards.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The angel Sorin made to solve the vampire problem, who perished.

entities.name: Bruna
entities.description: An archangel Sorin remembers as thoughtful and reserved.

entities.name: Gisela
entities.description: An archangel Sorin remembers for her bluster and fire-and-brimstone approach.

entities.name: The false priest
entities.description: A vampire dressed as an Avacynian priest and Lunarch who officiates the wedding.

entities.name: Markov family
entities.description: Sorin's vampire relatives gathered on the groom's side.

entities.name: Voldaren family
entities.description: Olivia's house, whose manor hosts the wedding.

entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: A vessel of magical energy that, with the Sungold lock, forms a sphere for the binding ritual and releases a witch's spirit.

entities.name: Sungold Lock
entities.description: The lock that forms a sphere with the Moonsilver Key.

entities.name: Voldaren Manor
entities.description: Olivia's manor with stained-glass windows where the wedding is held.

entities.name: Markov manor
entities.description: Sorin's home where he was made a vampire in a memory.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Mentioned as not immune to the magical energy of Moonsilver.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane Olivia plans to rule.

events.summary: Sorin, chained, studies Olivia's stained-glass window and reflects that her life has marched toward this moment of seized power.
events.quote: The larger picture of Olivia's life has always marched toward this.

events.summary: Olivia welcomes the guests and promises a present for Edgar before the wedding.
events.quote: I have a little something else planned first.

events.summary: A cage draped in red descends from the ceiling, and Sorin recalls being forced by his grandfather to drink angel blood.
events.quote: a familiar scent comes to him—angel blood.

events.summary: The curtains fall to reveal Sigarda bound with red ribbons as a living gift.
events.quote: There is no cage save Sigarda's own wings

events.summary: Sorin works out that Olivia plans to control angels by drinking Sigarda's blood bound with the Moonsilver Key and Sungold lock.
events.quote: Olivia Voldaren with control over all the angels in Innistrad.

events.summary: The false priest begins the ceremony, and Olivia speaks vows to Edgar that mock him.
events.quote: And I promise to grant you the honor of being my husband.

events.summary: Sorin uses blood magic to cut his chains and objects to the wedding.
events.quote: A blade of red-black slices through the chains as easily as any sword.

events.summary: Outside, the allies joke about whether there is cake at a vampire wedding.
events.quote: "Do you think there's cake in there?"

events.summary: Sorin fights through the guards and seizes a gold-encrusted sword to kill Olivia.
events.quote: Three more fall in quick succession, crushed beneath the weight of the new weapon.

events.summary: A flash of light throws off Sorin's cut, and Olivia drops the Moonsilver Key.
events.quote: Grasping for the now-falling key, Olivia is furious.

events.summary: A witch's spirit bursts from the Moonsilver Key, grows a staff and asks Olivia whether she would stoop so low.
events.quote: this is someone's spirit, separated from their body.

events.summary: Sorin shoves his grandfather aside and fights Olivia to buy the spirit time, and a verdant bolt frees Sigarda.
events.quote: he dashes between her and the key, meeting her head-on charge with a wild slash.

events.summary: Sigarda rises freed, declares all of them guilty and shatters the hall with holy light.
events.quote: "All of you are guilty," speaks the angel.

events.summary: Outside, Chandra and Adeline see golden light and the invitation wards crumbling.

relations.quote: The way his grandfather dotingly pats her hand makes him want to scream.
has pledged her heart to Edgar Markov
And in the days before he made Avacyn
he wonders just how it was that Olivia captured her
He'll endure anything if it means he can tear Olivia Voldaren's head from her body.

relations.note: He fights to give the spirit time to free her.
relations.quote: Sorin smiles right back in Olivia's face.

relations.note: Adeline admires the light in Chandra's eyes.
relations.quote: the light in Chandra's eyes is beautiful
